Fails if either the user or the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Wonder Guard, or Zen Mode.

moves.name: Skitter Smack
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.

moves.name: Skull Bash
moves.description: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Raises the user's Defense by 1 stage on the first turn. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

moves.name: Sky Attack
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch and a higher chance for a critical hit. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

moves.name: Slack Off
moves.description: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.

moves.name: Slam
moves.description: No additional effect.

moves.name: Slash
moves.description: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

moves.name: Sleep Powder
moves.description: Causes the target to fall asleep.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: One of the user's known moves, besides this move, is selected for use at random. Fails if the user is not asleep. The selected move does not have PP deducted from it, and can currently have 0 PP. This move cannot select Assist, Beak Blast, Belch, Bide, Celebrate, Chatter, Copycat, Dynamax Cannon, Focus Punch, Hold Hands, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Shell Trap, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Uproar, any two-turn move, or any Max Move.

moves.name: Sludge
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

moves.name: Sludge Bomb
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

moves.name: Sludge Wave
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to poison the target.

moves.name: Smack Down
moves.description: This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop. If this move hits a target under the effect of Bounce, Fly, Magnet Rise, or Telekinesis, the effect ends. If the target is a Flying type that has not used Roost this turn or a Pokemon with the Levitate Ability, it loses its immunity to Ground-type attacks and the Arena Trap Ability as long as it remains active. During the effect, Magnet Rise fails for the target and Telekinesis fails against the target.

moves.name: Smart Strike
moves.description: This move does not check accuracy.

moves.name: Smog
moves.description: Has a 40% chance to poison the target.

moves.name: Smokescreen
moves.description: Lowers the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

moves.name: Snap Trap
moves.description: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Rapid Spin or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

moves.name: Snarl
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.

moves.name: Snipe Shot
moves.description: Has a higher chance for a critical hit. This move cannot be redirected to a different target by any effect.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch. Fails if the user is not asleep.

moves.name: Soak
moves.description: Causes the target to become a Water type. Fails if the target is an Arceus or a Silvally, or if the target is already purely Water type.

moves.name: Soft-Boiled
moves.description: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.description: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Power is halved if the weather is Hail, Heavy Rain, Rain, or Sandstorm and the user is not holding Utility Umbrella. If the user is holding a Power Herb or the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, the move completes in one turn. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, the move still requires a turn to charge.

moves.name: Solar Blade
moves.description: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Power is halved if the weather is Hail, Heavy Rain, Rain, or Sandstorm and the user is not holding Utility Umbrella. If the user is holding a Power Herb or the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, the move completes in one turn. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, the move still requires a turn to charge.

moves.name: Spacial Rend
moves.description: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

moves.name: Spark
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Sparkling Aria
moves.description: If the user has not fainted, the target is cured of its burn.

moves.name: Spectral Thief
moves.description: The target's stat stages greater than 0 are stolen from it and applied to the user before dealing damage.

moves.name: Speed Swap
moves.description: The user swaps its Speed stat with the target. Stat stage changes are unaffected.

moves.name: Spikes
moves.description: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Can be used up to three times before failing. Opponents lose 1/8 of their maximum HP with one layer, 1/6 of their maximum HP with two layers, and 1/4 of their maximum HP with three layers, all rounded down. Can be removed from the opposing side if any opposing Pokemon uses Rapid Spin or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.

moves.name: Spiky Shield
moves.description: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon making contact with the user lose 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

moves.name: Spirit Break
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.

moves.name: Spirit Shackle
moves.description: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.

moves.name: Spite
moves.description: Causes the target's last move used to lose 4 PP. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, or if it no longer knows the move.

moves.name: Spit Up
moves.description: Power is equal to 100 times the user's Stockpile count. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 0. Whether or not this move is successful, the user's Defense and Special Defense decrease by as many stages as Stockpile had increased them, and the user's Stockpile count resets to 0.

moves.name: Splash
moves.description: No competitive use.

moves.name: Spore
moves.description: Causes the target to fall asleep.

moves.name: Stealth Rock
moves.description: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in. Fails if the effect is already active on the opposing side. Foes lose 1/32, 1/16, 1/8, 1/4, or 1/2 of their maximum HP, rounded down, based on their weakness to the Rock type; 0.25×, 0.5×, neutral, 2×, or 4×, respectively. Can be removed from the opposing side if any opposing Pokemon uses Rapid Spin or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.

moves.name: Steam Eruption
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to burn the target. The target thaws out if it is frozen.

moves.name: Steel Beam
moves.description: Whether or not this move is successful and even if it would cause fainting, the user loses 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded up, unless the user has the Magic Guard Ability.

moves.name: Steel Roller
moves.description: Fails if there is no terrain active. Ends the effects of Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain, and Psychic Terrain.

moves.name: Steel Wing
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Sticky Web
moves.description: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, lowering the Speed by 1 stage of each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Fails if the effect is already active on the opposing side. Can be removed from the opposing side if any opposing Pokemon uses Rapid Spin or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.

moves.name: Stockpile
moves.description: Raises the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage. The user's Stockpile count increases by 1. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 3. The user's Stockpile count is reset to 0 when it is no longer active.

moves.name: Stomp
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

moves.name: Stomping Tantrum
moves.description: Power doubles if the user's last move on the previous turn, including moves called by other moves or those used through Instruct, Magic Coat, Snatch, or the Dancer or Magic Bounce Abilities, failed to do any of its normal effects, not including damage from an unsuccessful High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, or Mind Blown, or if the user was prevented from moving by any effect other than recharging or Sky Drop. A move that was blocked by Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, Spiky Shield, Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard will not double this move's power, nor will Bounce or Fly ending early due to the effect of Gravity, Smack Down, or Thousand Arrows.

moves.name: Stone Edge
moves.description: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

moves.name: Stored Power
moves.description: Power is equal to 20+(X × 20), where X is the user's total stat stage changes that are greater than 0.

moves.name: Storm Throw
moves.description: This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities.

moves.name: Strange Steam
moves.description: Has a 20% chance to confuse the target.

moves.name: Strength
moves.description: No additional effect.

moves.name: Strength Sap
moves.description: Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage. The user restores its HP equal to the target's Attack stat calculated with its stat stage before this move was used. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down. Fails if the target's Attack stat stage is -6.

moves.name: String Shot
moves.description: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages.

moves.name: Struggle
moves.description: Deals typeless damage to a random opposing Pokemon. If this move was successful, the user loses 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half up, and the Rock Head Ability does not prevent this. This move is automatically used if none of the user's known moves can be selected.

moves.name: Struggle Bug
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.

moves.name: Stuff Cheeks
moves.description: This move cannot be selected unless the user is holding a Berry. The user eats its Berry and raises its Defense by 2 stages. This effect is not prevented by the Klutz or Unnerve Abilities, or the effects of Embargo or Magic Room. Fails if the user is not holding a Berry.

moves.name: Stun Spore
moves.description: Paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Submission
moves.description: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user takes 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, and puts it into a substitute to take its place in battle. The substitute is removed once enough damage is inflicted on it, or if the user switches out or faints. Baton Pass can be used to transfer the substitute to an ally, and the substitute will keep its remaining HP. Until the substitute is broken, it receives damage from all attacks made by other Pokemon and shields the user from status effects and stat stage changes caused by other Pokemon. Sound-based moves and Pokemon with the Infiltrator Ability ignore substitutes. The user still takes normal damage from weather and status effects while behind its substitute. If the substitute breaks during a multi-hit attack, the user will take damage from any remaining hits. If a substitute is created while the user is trapped by a binding move, the binding effect ends immediately. Fails if the user does not have enough HP remaining to create a substitute without fainting, or if it already has a substitute.

moves.name: Sucker Punch
moves.description: Fails if the target did not select a physical attack, special attack, or Me First for use this turn, or if the target moves before the user.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Sun. The damage of Fire-type attacks is multiplied by 1.5 and the damage of Water-type attacks is multiplied by 0.5 during the effect. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Heat Rock. Fails if the current weather is Sun.

moves.name: Sunsteel Strike
moves.description: This move and its effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.

moves.name: Super Fang
moves.description: Deals damage to the target equal to half of its current HP, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.

moves.name: Superpower
moves.description: Lowers the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Supersonic
moves.description: Causes the target to become confused.

moves.name: Surf
moves.description: Damage doubles if the target is using Dive.

moves.name: Surging Strikes
moves.description: Hits three times. This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities.

moves.name: Swagger
moves.description: Raises the target's Attack by 2 stages and confuses it.

moves.name: Swallow
moves.description: The user restores its HP based on its Stockpile count. Restores 1/4 of its maximum HP if it's 1, 1/2 of its maximum HP if it's 2, both rounded half down, and all of its HP if it's 3. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 0. The user's Defense and Special Defense decrease by as many stages as Stockpile had increased them, and the user's Stockpile count resets to 0.

moves.name: Sweet Kiss
moves.description: Causes the target to become confused.

moves.name: Sweet Scent
moves.description: Lowers the target's evasiveness by 2 stages.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: This move does not check accuracy.

moves.name: Switcheroo
moves.description: The user swaps its held item with the target's held item. Fails if both the user and the target have no held item, or if the user is trying to give or take a Blue Orb, Red Orb, Griseous Orb, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, or Rusted Shield to or from a Kyogre, Groudon, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, Silvally, Zacian, or Zamazenta, respectively. The target is immune to this move if it has the Sticky Hold Ability.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.description: Raises the user's Attack by 2 stages.

moves.name: Synthesis
moves.description: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP if Strong Winds or no weather conditions are in effect or if the user is holding Utility Umbrella, 2/3 of its maximum HP if the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, and 1/4 of its maximum HP if the weather is Hail, Heavy Rain, Rain, or Sandstorm, all rounded half down.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: No additional effect.

moves.name: Tail Slap
moves.description: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times.

moves.name: Tail Whip
moves.description: Lowers the target's Defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Tailwind
moves.description: For 4 turns, the user and its party members have their Speed doubled. Fails if this move is already in effect for the user's side.

moves.name: Take Down
moves.description: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

moves.name: Tar Shot
moves.description: Lowers the target's Speed by 1 stage. Until the target switches out, the effectiveness of Fire-type moves is doubled against it.

moves.name: Taunt
moves.description: Prevents the target from using non-damaging moves for its next three turns. Pokemon with the Oblivious Ability or protected by the Aroma Veil Ability are immune.

moves.name: Tearful Look
moves.description: Lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage.

moves.name: Teatime
moves.description: All active Pokemon consume their held Berries. This effect is not prevented by substitutes, the Klutz or Unnerve Abilities, or the effects of Embargo or Magic Room. Fails if no active Pokemon is holding a Berry.

moves.name: Techno Blast
moves.description: This move's type depends on the user's held Drive.

moves.name: Teeter Dance
moves.description: Causes the target to become confused.

moves.name: Teleport
moves.description: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members.

moves.name: Terrain Pulse
moves.description: Power doubles if the user is grounded and a terrain is active, and this move's type changes to match. Electric type during Electric Terrain, Grass type during Grassy Terrain, Fairy type during Misty Terrain, and Psychic type during Psychic Terrain.

moves.name: Thief
moves.description: If this attack was successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held item if the user is not holding one. A target with the Sticky Hold Ability does not lose its held item if it has not fainted. The target's item is not stolen if it is a Blue Orb, Red Orb, Griseous Orb, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, or Rusted Shield held by a Kyogre, Groudon, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, Silvally, Zacian, or Zamazenta, respectively, or if the user is one of those species and the target is holding the respective item. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

moves.name: Thousand Arrows
moves.description: This move can hit airborne Pokemon, which includes Flying-type Pokemon, Pokemon with the Levitate Ability, Pokemon holding an Air Balloon, and Pokemon under the effect of Magnet Rise or Telekinesis. If the target is a Flying type and is not already grounded, this move deals neutral damage regardless of its other type(s). This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop. If this move hits a target under the effect of Bounce, Fly, Magnet Rise, or Telekinesis, the effect ends. If the target is a Flying type that has not used Roost this turn or a Pokemon with the Levitate Ability, it loses its immunity to Ground-type attacks and the Arena Trap Ability as long as it remains active. During the effect, Magnet Rise fails for the target and Telekinesis fails against the target.

moves.name: Thousand Waves
moves.description: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.

moves.name: Thrash
moves.description: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused immediately after its move on the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk and the user is asleep, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.

moves.name: Throat Chop
moves.description: For 2 turns, the target cannot use sound-based moves.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop. If the weather is Heavy Rain or Rain, this move does not check accuracy. If the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, this move's accuracy is 50%. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 70%.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Thunder Cage
moves.description: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Rapid Spin or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

moves.name: Thunder Fang
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target and a 10% chance to make it flinch.

moves.name: Thunderous Kick
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Thunder Punch
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Thunder Shock
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.description: Paralyzes the target. This move does not ignore type immunity.

moves.name: Tickle
moves.description: Lowers the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Topsy-Turvy
moves.description: The target's positive stat stages become negative and vice versa. Fails if all of the target's stat stages are 0.

moves.name: Torment
moves.description: Prevents the target from selecting the same move for use two turns in a row. This effect ends when the target is no longer active.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description: Badly poisons the target. If a Poison-type Pokemon uses this move, the target cannot avoid the attack, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move.

moves.name: Toxic Spikes
moves.description: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, poisoning each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Can be used up to two times before failing. Opposing Pokemon become poisoned with one layer and badly poisoned with two layers. Can be removed from the opposing side if any opposing Pokemon uses Rapid Spin or Defog successfully, is hit by Defog, or a grounded Poison-type Pokemon switches in. Safeguard prevents the opposing party from being poisoned on switch-in, but a substitute does not.

moves.name: Transform
moves.description: The user transforms into the target. The target's current stats, stat stages, types, moves, Ability, weight, gender, and sprite are copied. The user's level and HP remain the same and each copied move receives only 5 PP, with a maximum of 5 PP each. The user can no longer change formes if it would have the ability to do so. This move fails if it hits a substitute, if either the user or the target is already transformed, or if either is behind an Illusion.

moves.name: Tri Attack
moves.description: Has a 20% chance to either burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.

moves.name: Trick
moves.description: The user swaps its held item with the target's held item. Fails if both the user and the target have no held item, or if the user is trying to give or take a Blue Orb, Red Orb, Griseous Orb, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, or Rusted Shield to or from a Kyogre, Groudon, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, Silvally, Zacian, or Zamazenta, respectively. The target is immune to this move if it has the Sticky Hold Ability.

moves.name: Trick-or-Treat
moves.description: Causes the Ghost type to be added to the target, effectively making it have two or three types. Fails if the target is already a Ghost type. If Forest's Curse adds a type to the target, it replaces the type added by this move and vice versa.

moves.name: Trick Room
moves.description: For 5 turns, the Speed of every Pokemon is recalculated for the purposes of determining turn order. During the effect, each Pokemon's Speed is considered to be (10000 - its normal Speed), and if this value is greater than 8191, 8192 is subtracted from it. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.

moves.name: Triple Axel
moves.description: Hits three times. Power increases to 40 for the second hit and 60 for the third. This move checks accuracy for each hit, and the attack ends if the target avoids a hit. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit three times.

moves.name: Triple Kick
moves.description: Hits three times. Power increases to 20 for the second hit and 30 for the third. This move checks accuracy for each hit, and the attack ends if the target avoids a hit. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit three times.

moves.name: Trop Kick
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.

moves.name: Twister
moves.description: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch. Power doubles if the target is using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop.

moves.name: Uproar
moves.description: The user spends three turns locked into this move. This move targets an opponent at random on each turn. On the first of the three turns, all sleeping active Pokemon wake up. During the three turns, no active Pokemon can fall asleep by any means, and Pokemon switched in during the effect do not wake up. If the user is prevented from moving or the attack is not successful against the target during one of the turns, the effect ends.

moves.name: U-turn
moves.description: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.

moves.name: Vacuum Wave
moves.description: No additional effect.

moves.name: V-create
moves.description: Lowers the user's Speed, Defense, and Special Defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Venom Drench
moves.description: Lowers the target's Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by 1 stage if the target is poisoned. Fails if the target is not poisoned.

moves.name: Venoshock
moves.description: Power doubles if the target is poisoned.

moves.name: Vine Whip
moves.description: No additional effect.

moves.name: Vise Grip
moves.description: No additional effect.

moves.name: Vital Throw
moves.description: This move does not check accuracy.

moves.name: Volt Switch
moves.description: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.

moves.name: Volt Tackle
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target. If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

moves.name: Waterfall
moves.description: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Water Gun
moves.description: No additional effect.

moves.name: Water Pledge
moves.description: If one of the user's allies chose to use Fire Pledge or Grass Pledge this turn and has not moved yet, it takes its turn immediately after the user and the user's move does nothing. If combined with Fire Pledge, the ally uses Water Pledge with 150 power and a rainbow appears on the user's side for 4 turns, which doubles secondary effect chances and stacks with the Serene Grace Ability, except effects that cause flinching can only have their chance doubled once. If combined with Grass Pledge, the ally uses Grass Pledge with 150 power and a swamp appears on the target's side for 4 turns, which quarters the Speed of each Pokemon on that side. When used as a combined move, this move gains STAB no matter what the user's type is. This move does not consume the user's Water Gem, and cannot be redirected by the Storm Drain Ability.

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.description: Has a 20% chance to confuse the target.

moves.name: Water Shuriken
moves.description: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times.

moves.name: Water Spout
moves.description: Power is equal to (user's current HP × 150 / user's maximum HP), rounded down, but not less than 1.

moves.name: Weather Ball
moves.description: Power doubles if a weather condition other than Strong Winds is active, and this move's type changes to match. Ice type during Hail, Water type during Heavy Rain or Rain, Rock type during Sandstorm, and Fire type during Intense Sun or Sun. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and uses Weather Ball during Heavy Rain, Rain, Intense Sun, or Sun, this move remains Normal type and does not double in power.

moves.name: Whirlpool
moves.description: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Rapid Spin or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

moves.name: Whirlwind
moves.description: The target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. Fails if the target is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party, or if the target used Ingrain previously or has the Suction Cups Ability.

moves.name: Wicked Blow
moves.description: This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities.

moves.name: Wide Guard
moves.description: The user and its party members are protected from moves made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn that target all adjacent foes or all adjacent Pokemon. This move modifies the same 1/X chance of being successful used by other protection moves, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used, but does not use the chance to check for failure. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.

moves.name: Wild Charge
moves.description: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

moves.name: Will-O-Wisp
moves.description: Burns the target.

moves.name: Wing Attack
moves.description: No additional effect.

moves.name: Wish
moves.description: At the end of the next turn, the Pokemon at the user's position has 1/2 of the user's maximum HP restored to it, rounded down. Fails if this move is already in effect for the user's position.

moves.name: Withdraw
moves.description: Raises the user's Defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Wonder Room
moves.description: For 5 turns, all active Pokemon have their Defense and Special Defense stats swapped. Stat stage changes are unaffected. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.

moves.name: Wood Hammer
moves.description: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

moves.name: Work Up
moves.description: Raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage.

moves.name: Worry Seed
moves.description: Causes the target's Ability to become Insomnia. Fails if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Insomnia, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Truant, or Zen Mode.

moves.name: Wrap
moves.description: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Rapid Spin or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

moves.name: X-Scissor
moves.description: No additional effect.

moves.name: Yawn
moves.description: Causes the target to fall asleep at the end of the next turn. Fails when used if the target cannot fall asleep or if it already has a non-volatile status condition. At the end of the next turn, if the target is still active, does not have a non-volatile status condition, and can fall asleep, it falls asleep. If the target becomes affected, this effect cannot be prevented by Safeguard or a substitute, or by falling asleep and waking up during the effect.

moves.name: Zap Cannon
moves.description: Has a 100% chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.description: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Zing Zap
moves.description: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

abilities.name: Adaptability
abilities.description: This Pokemon's moves that match one of its types have a same-type attack bonus (STAB) of 2 instead of 1.5.

abilities.name: Aftermath
abilities.description: If this Pokemon is knocked out with a contact move, that move's user loses 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down. This effect is prevented if the move's user has the Magic Guard Ability or if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.

abilities.name: Air Lock
abilities.description: While this Pokemon is active, the effects of weather conditions are disabled.

abilities.name: Analytic
abilities.description: The power of this Pokemon's move is multiplied by 1.3 if it is the last to move in a turn. Does not affect Doom Desire and Future Sight.

abilities.name: Anger Point
abilities.description: If this Pokemon, but not its substitute, is struck by a critical hit, its Attack is raised by 12 stages.

abilities.name: Anticipation
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon is alerted if any opposing Pokemon has an attacking move with a type that is super effective against this Pokemon, or any OHKO move. This effect considers Hidden Power to be its determined type, and every other move to be its original type.

abilities.name: Arena Trap
abilities.description: Prevents opposing Pokemon from choosing to switch out unless they are airborne, are holding a Shed Shell, or are a Ghost type.

abilities.name: Aroma Veil
abilities.description: This Pokemon and its allies cannot become affected by Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, or Torment.

abilities.name: As One (Glastrier)
abilities.description: Combination of the Unnerve and Chilling Neigh Abilities.

abilities.name: As One (Spectrier)
abilities.description: Combination of the Unnerve and Grim Neigh Abilities.

abilities.name: Aura Break
abilities.description: While this Pokemon is active, the effects of the Dark Aura and Fairy Aura Abilities are reversed, multiplying the power of Dark- and Fairy-type moves, respectively, by 3/4 instead of 1.33.

abilities.name: Ball Fetch
abilities.description: No competitive use.

abilities.name: Battery
abilities.description: This Pokemon's allies have the power of their special attacks multiplied by 1.3.

abilities.name: Battle Armor
abilities.description: This Pokemon cannot be struck by a critical hit.

abilities.name: Beast Boost
abilities.description: This Pokemon's highest stat is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon. Stat stage changes are not considered. If multiple stats are tied, Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed are prioritized in that order.

abilities.name: Berserk
abilities.description: When this Pokemon has more than 1/2 its maximum HP and takes damage from an attack bringing it to 1/2 or less of its maximum HP, its Special Attack is raised by 1 stage. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability.

abilities.name: Big Pecks
abilities.description: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's Defense stat stage.

abilities.name: Blaze
abilities.description: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Fire-type attack.

abilities.name: Bulletproof
abilities.description: This Pokemon is immune to bullet moves.

abilities.name: Cheek Pouch
abilities.description: If this Pokemon eats a held Berry, it restores 1/3 of its maximum HP, rounded down, in addition to the Berry's effect. This effect can also activate after the effects of Bug Bite, Fling, Pluck, Stuff Cheeks, and Teatime if the eaten Berry had an effect on this Pokemon.

abilities.name: Chilling Neigh
abilities.description: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon.

abilities.name: Chlorophyll
abilities.description: If Sun is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

abilities.name: Clear Body
abilities.description: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.

abilities.name: Cloud Nine
abilities.description: While this Pokemon is active, the effects of weather conditions are disabled.

abilities.name: Competitive
abilities.description: This Pokemon's Special Attack is raised by 2 stages for each of its stat stages that is lowered by an opposing Pokemon.

abilities.name: Compound Eyes
abilities.description: This Pokemon's moves have their accuracy multiplied by 1.3.

abilities.name: Contrary
abilities.description: If this Pokemon has a stat stage raised it is lowered instead, and vice versa.

abilities.name: Corrosion
abilities.description: This Pokemon can poison or badly poison a Pokemon regardless of its typing.

abilities.name: Cotton Down
abilities.description: When this Pokemon is hit by an attack, the Speed of all other Pokemon on the field is lowered by 1 stage.

abilities.name: Curious Medicine
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon's allies have their stat stages reset to 0.

abilities.name: Cursed Body
abilities.description: If this Pokemon is hit by an attack, there is a 30% chance that move gets disabled unless one of the attacker's moves is already disabled.

abilities.name: Cute Charm
abilities.description: There is a 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will become infatuated if it is of the opposite gender.

abilities.name: Damp
abilities.description: While this Pokemon is active, Explosion, Mind Blown, Misty Explosion, Self-Destruct, and the Aftermath Ability are prevented from having an effect.

abilities.name: Dark Aura
abilities.description: While this Pokemon is active, the power of Dark-type moves used by active Pokemon is multiplied by 1.33.

abilities.name: Dauntless Shield
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon's Defense is raised by 1 stage.

abilities.name: Defeatist
abilities.description: While this Pokemon has 1/2 or less of its maximum HP, its Attack and Special Attack are halved.

abilities.name: Defiant
abilities.description: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 2 stages for each of its stat stages that is lowered by an opposing Pokemon.

abilities.name: Disguise
abilities.description: If this Pokemon is a Mimikyu, the first hit it takes in battle deals 0 neutral damage. Its disguise is then broken, it changes to Busted Form, and it loses 1/8 of its max HP. Confusion damage also breaks the disguise.

abilities.name: Download
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon's Attack or Special Attack is raised by 1 stage based on the weaker combined defensive stat of all opposing Pokemon. Attack is raised if their Defense is lower, and Special Attack is raised if their Special Defense is the same or lower.

abilities.name: Dragon's Maw
abilities.description: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Dragon-type attack.

abilities.name: Drizzle
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Rain.

abilities.name: Drought
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Sun.

abilities.name: Dry Skin
abilities.description: This Pokemon is immune to Water-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by a Water-type move. The power of Fire-type moves is multiplied by 1.25 when used on this Pokemon. At the end of each turn, this Pokemon restores 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, if the weather is Rain, and loses 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, if the weather is Sun. The weather effects are prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

abilities.name: Early Bird
abilities.description: This Pokemon's sleep counter drops by 2 instead of 1.

abilities.name: Effect Spore
abilities.description: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be poisoned, paralyzed, or fall asleep.

abilities.name: Electric Surge
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Electric Terrain.

abilities.name: Emergency Exit
abilities.description: When this Pokemon has more than 1/2 its maximum HP and takes damage bringing it to 1/2 or less of its maximum HP, it immediately switches out to a chosen ally. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability. This effect applies to both direct and indirect damage, except Curse and Substitute on use, Belly Drum, Pain Split, and confusion damage.

abilities.name: Fairy Aura
abilities.description: While this Pokemon is active, the power of Fairy-type moves used by active Pokemon is multiplied by 1.33.

abilities.name: Filter
abilities.description: This Pokemon receives 3/4 damage from supereffective attacks.

abilities.name: Flame Body
abilities.description: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be burned.

abilities.name: Flare Boost
abilities.description: While this Pokemon is burned, the power of its special attacks is multiplied by 1.5.

abilities.name: Flash Fire
abilities.description: This Pokemon is immune to Fire-type moves. The first time it is hit by a Fire-type move, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Fire-type attack as long as it remains active and has this Ability. If this Pokemon is frozen, it cannot be defrosted by Fire-type attacks.

abilities.name: Flower Gift
abilities.description: If this Pokemon is a Cherrim and Sun is active, it changes to Sunshine Form and the Attack and Special Defense of it and its allies are multiplied by 1.5. These effects are prevented if the Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

abilities.name: Flower Veil
abilities.description: Grass-type Pokemon on this Pokemon's side cannot have their stat stages lowered by other Pokemon or have a non-volatile status condition inflicted on them by other Pokemon.

abilities.name: Fluffy
abilities.description: This Pokemon receives 1/2 damage from contact moves, but double damage from Fire moves.

abilities.name: Forewarn
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon is alerted to the move with the highest power, at random, known by an opposing Pokemon. This effect considers OHKO moves to have 150 power, Counter, Mirror Coat, and Metal Burst to have 120 power, every other attacking move with an unspecified power to have 80 power, and non-damaging moves to have 1 power.

abilities.name: Friend Guard
abilities.description: This Pokemon's allies receive 3/4 damage from other Pokemon's attacks.

abilities.name: Frisk
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon identifies the held items of all opposing Pokemon.

abilities.name: Full Metal Body
abilities.description: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.

abilities.name: Fur Coat
abilities.description: This Pokemon's Defense is doubled.

abilities.name: Gale Wings
abilities.description: If this Pokemon is at full HP, its Flying-type moves have their priority increased by 1.

abilities.name: Gluttony
abilities.description: When this Pokemon is holding a Berry that usually activates with 1/4 or less of its maximum HP, it is eaten at 1/2 or less of its maximum HP instead.

abilities.name: Gooey
abilities.description: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Speed lowered by 1 stage.

abilities.name: Gorilla Tactics
abilities.description: This Pokemon's Attack is multiplied by 1.5, but it can only select the first move it executes. These effects are prevented while this Pokemon is Dynamaxed.

abilities.name: Grassy Surge
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Grassy Terrain.

abilities.name: Grim Neigh
abilities.description: This Pokemon's Special Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon.

abilities.name: Gulp Missile
abilities.description: If this Pokemon is a Cramorant, it changes forme when it hits a target with Surf or uses the first turn of Dive successfully. It becomes Gulping Form with an Arrokuda in its mouth if it has more than 1/2 of its maximum HP remaining, or Gorging Form with a Pikachu in its mouth if it has 1/2 or less of its maximum HP remaining. If Cramorant gets hit in Gulping or Gorging Form, it spits the Arrokuda or Pikachu at its attacker, even if it has no HP remaining. The projectile deals damage equal to 1/4 of the target's maximum HP, rounded down; this damage is blocked by the Magic Guard Ability but not by a substitute. An Arrokuda also lowers the target's Defense by 1 stage, and a Pikachu paralyzes the target. Cramorant will return to normal if it spits out a projectile, switches out, or Dynamaxes.

abilities.name: Guts
abilities.description: If this Pokemon has a non-volatile status condition, its Attack is multiplied by 1.5. This Pokemon's physical attacks ignore the burn effect of halving damage.

abilities.name: Harvest
abilities.description: If the last item this Pokemon used is a Berry, there is a 50% chance it gets restored at the end of each turn. If Sun is active, this chance is 100%.

abilities.name: Healer
abilities.description: 30% chance this Pokemon's ally has its non-volatile status condition cured at the end of each turn.

abilities.name: Heatproof
abilities.description: The power of Fire-type attacks against this Pokemon is halved. This Pokemon takes half of the usual burn damage, rounded down.

abilities.name: Heavy Metal
abilities.description: This Pokemon's weight is doubled. This effect is calculated after the effect of Autotomize, and before the effect of Float Stone.

abilities.name: Honey Gather
abilities.description: No competitive use.

abilities.name: Huge Power
abilities.description: This Pokemon's Attack is doubled.

abilities.name: Hunger Switch
abilities.description: If this Pokemon is a Morpeko, it changes formes between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode at the end of each turn.

abilities.name: Hustle
abilities.description: This Pokemon's Attack is multiplied by 1.5 and the accuracy of its physical attacks is multiplied by 0.8.

abilities.name: Hydration
abilities.description: This Pokemon has its non-volatile status condition cured at the end of each turn if Rain is active. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

abilities.name: Hyper Cutter
abilities.description: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's Attack stat stage.

abilities.name: Ice Body
abilities.description: If Hail is active, this Pokemon restores 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn. This Pokemon takes no damage from Hail.

abilities.name: Ice Face
abilities.description: If this Pokemon is an Eiscue, the first physical hit it takes in battle deals 0 neutral damage. Its ice face is then broken and it changes forme to Noice Face. Eiscue regains its Ice Face forme when Hail begins or when Eiscue switches in while Hail is active. Confusion damage also breaks the ice face.

abilities.name: Ice Scales
abilities.description: This Pokemon receives 1/2 damage from special attacks.

abilities.name: Illuminate
abilities.description: No competitive use.

abilities.name: Illusion
abilities.description: When this Pokemon switches in, it appears as the last unfainted Pokemon in its party until it takes direct damage from another Pokemon's attack. This Pokemon's actual level and HP are displayed instead of those of the mimicked Pokemon.

abilities.name: Immunity
abilities.description: This Pokemon cannot be poisoned. Gaining this Ability while poisoned cures it.

abilities.name: Imposter
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon Transforms into the opposing Pokemon that is facing it. If there is no Pokemon at that position, this Pokemon does not Transform.

abilities.name: Infiltrator
abilities.description: This Pokemon's moves ignore substitutes and the opposing side's Reflect, Light Screen, Safeguard, Mist, and Aurora Veil.

abilities.name: Innards Out
abilities.description: If this Pokemon is knocked out with a move, that move's user loses HP equal to the amount of damage inflicted on this Pokemon.

abilities.name: Inner Focus
abilities.description: This Pokemon cannot be made to flinch. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.

abilities.name: Insomnia
abilities.description: This Pokemon cannot fall asleep. Gaining this Ability while asleep cures it.

abilities.name: Intimidate
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the Attack of opposing Pokemon by 1 stage. Pokemon with the Inner Focus, Oblivious, Own Tempo, or Scrappy Abilities and Pokemon behind a substitute are immune.

abilities.name: Intrepid Sword
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage.

abilities.name: Iron Barbs
abilities.description: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon lose 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down.

abilities.name: Iron Fist
abilities.description: This Pokemon's punch-based attacks have their power multiplied by 1.2.

abilities.name: Justified
abilities.description: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage after it is damaged by a Dark-type move.

abilities.name: Keen Eye
abilities.description: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's accuracy stat stage. This Pokemon ignores a target's evasiveness stat stage.

abilities.name: Klutz
abilities.description: This Pokemon's held item has no effect. This Pokemon cannot use Fling successfully. Macho Brace, Power Anklet, Power Band, Power Belt, Power Bracer, Power Lens, and Power Weight still have their effects.

abilities.name: Leaf Guard
abilities.description: If Sun is active, this Pokemon cannot become affected by a non-volatile status condition or Yawn, and Rest will fail for it. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

abilities.name: Levitate
abilities.description: This Pokemon is immune to Ground-type attacks and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability. The effects of Gravity, Ingrain, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, and Iron Ball nullify the immunity. Thousand Arrows can hit this Pokemon as if it did not have this Ability.

abilities.name: Libero
abilities.description: This Pokemon's type changes to match the type of the move it is about to use. This effect comes after all effects that change a move's type.

abilities.name: Light Metal
abilities.description: This Pokemon's weight is halved, rounded down to a tenth of a kilogram. This effect is calculated after the effect of Autotomize, and before the effect of Float Stone. A Pokemon's weight will not drop below 0.1 kg.

abilities.name: Lightning Rod
abilities.description: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and raises its Special Attack by 1 stage when hit by an Electric-type move. If this Pokemon is not the target of a single-target Electric-type move used by another Pokemon, this Pokemon redirects that move to itself if it is within the range of that move. If multiple Pokemon could redirect with this Ability, it goes to the one with the highest Speed, or in the case of a tie to the one that has had this Ability active longer.

abilities.name: Limber
abilities.description: This Pokemon cannot be paralyzed. Gaining this Ability while paralyzed cures it.

abilities.name: Liquid Ooze
abilities.description: This Pokemon damages those draining HP from it for as much as they would heal.

abilities.name: Liquid Voice
abilities.description: This Pokemon's sound-based moves become Water-type moves. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.

abilities.name: Long Reach
abilities.description: This Pokemon's attacks do not make contact with the target.

abilities.name: Magic Bounce
abilities.description: This Pokemon is unaffected by certain non-damaging moves directed at it and will instead use such moves against the original user. Moves reflected in this way are unable to be reflected again by this or Magic Coat's effect. Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes can only be reflected once per side, by the leftmost Pokemon under this or Magic Coat's effect. The Lightning Rod and Storm Drain Abilities redirect their respective moves before this Ability takes effect.

abilities.name: Magic Guard
abilities.description: This Pokemon can only be damaged by direct attacks. Curse and Substitute on use, Belly Drum, Pain Split, Struggle recoil, and confusion damage are considered direct damage.

abilities.name: Magician
abilities.description: If this Pokemon has no item, it steals the item off a Pokemon it hits with an attack. Does not affect Doom Desire and Future Sight. If multiple targets are hit by an attack the item is stolen from the fastest Pokemon, while considering the effect of Trick Room and prioritizing opposing Pokemon before allies.

abilities.name: Magnet Pull
abilities.description: Prevents opposing Steel-type Pokemon from choosing to switch out, unless they are holding a Shed Shell or are a Ghost type.

abilities.name: Marvel Scale
abilities.description: If this Pokemon has a non-volatile status condition, its Defense is multiplied by 1.5.

abilities.name: Mega Launcher
abilities.description: This Pokemon's pulse moves have their power multiplied by 1.5. Heal Pulse restores 3/4 of a target's maximum HP, rounded half down.

abilities.name: Merciless
abilities.description: This Pokemon's attacks are critical hits if the target is poisoned.

abilities.name: Mimicry
abilities.description: This Pokemon's types change to match the active Terrain when this Pokemon acquires this Ability, or whenever a Terrain begins. Electric type during Electric Terrain, Grass type during Grassy Terrain, Fairy type during Misty Terrain, and Psychic type during Psychic Terrain. If this Ability is acquired without an active Terrain, or a Terrain ends, this Pokemon's types become the original types for its species.

abilities.name: Minus
abilities.description: If an active ally has this Ability or the Plus Ability, this Pokemon's Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5.

abilities.name: Mirror Armor
abilities.description: When one of this Pokemon's stat stages would be lowered by another Pokemon, that Pokemon's stat stage is lowered instead. This effect does not happen if this Pokemon's stat stage was already -6. If the other Pokemon has a substitute, neither Pokemon has its stat stage lowered.

abilities.name: Misty Surge
abilities.description: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Misty Terrain.

abilities.name: Mold Breaker
abilities.description: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore certain Abilities of other Pokemon. The Abilities that can be negated are Aroma Veil, Aura Break, Battle Armor, Big Pecks, Bulletproof, Clear Body, Contrary, Damp, Dazzling, Disguise, Dry Skin, Filter, Flash Fire, Flower Gift, Flower Veil, Fluffy, Friend Guard, Fur Coat, Grass Pelt, Heatproof, Heavy Metal, Hyper Cutter, Ice Face, Ice Scales, Immunity, Inner Focus, Insomnia, Keen Eye, Leaf Guard, Levitate, Light Metal, Lightning Rod, Limber, Magic Bounce, Magma Armor, Marvel Scale, Mirror Armor, Motor Drive, Multiscale, Oblivious, Overcoat, Own Tempo, Pastel Veil, Punk Rock, Queenly Majesty, Sand Veil, Sap Sipper, Shell Armor, Shield Dust, Simple, Snow Cloak, Solid Rock, Soundproof, Sticky Hold, Storm Drain, Sturdy, Suction Cups, Sweet Veil, Tangled Feet, Telepathy, Thick Fat, Unaware, Vital Spirit, Volt Absorb, Water Absorb, Water Bubble, Water Veil, White Smoke, Wonder Guard, and Wonder Skin. This affects every other Pokemon on the field, whether or not it is a target of this Pokemon's move, and whether or not their Ability is beneficial to this Pokemon.

abilities.name: Moody
abilities.description: This Pokemon has a random stat, other than accuracy or evasiveness, raised by 2 stages and another stat lowered by 1 stage at the end of each turn.

abilities.name: Motor Drive
abilities.description: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and raises its Speed by 1 stage when hit by an Electric-type move.

abilities.name: Moxie
abilities.description: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon.

abilities.name: Multiscale
abilities.description: If this Pokemon is at full HP, damage taken from attacks is halved.

abilities.name: Mummy
abilities.description: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Ability changed to Mummy. Does not affect Pokemon with the As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Mummy, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, or Zen Mode Abilities.

abilities.name: Natural Cure
abilities.description: This Pokemon has its non-volatile status condition cured when it switches out.

abilities.name: Neutralizing Gas
abilities.description: While this Pokemon is active, Abilities have no effect. This Ability activates before hazards and other Abilities take effect. Does not affect the As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, or Zen Mode Abilities.

abilities.name: No Guard
abilities.description: Every move used by or against this Pokemon will always hit.

abilities.name: Oblivious
abilities.description: This Pokemon cannot be infatuated or taunted. Gaining this Ability while infatuated or taunted cures it. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.

abilities.name: Overcoat
abilities.description: This Pokemon is immune to powder moves, damage from Sandstorm or Hail, and the effects of Rage Powder and the Effect Spore Ability.

abilities.name: Overgrow
abilities.description: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Grass-type attack.

abilities.name: Own Tempo
abilities.description: This Pokemon cannot be confused. Gaining this Ability while confused cures it. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.

abilities.name: Pastel Veil
abilities.description: This Pokemon and its allies cannot be poisoned. Gaining this Ability while this Pokemon or its ally is poisoned cures them. If this Ability is being ignored during an effect that causes poison, this Pokemon is cured immediately but its ally is not.

abilities.name: Perish Body
abilities.description: Making contact with this Pokemon starts the Perish Song effect for it and the attacker. This effect does not happen for this Pokemon if the attacker already has a perish count.

abilities.name: Pickpocket
abilities.description: If this Pokemon has no item and is hit by a contact move, it steals the attacker's item. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability.

abilities.name: Pickup

notes: Resolved Dex.mod('gen8') with complete gen8 -> base inheritance; nonstandard flags and available battleOnly parents define game availability, not tiers or competitive regulations.

Native getFullLearnset/getMovePool(false) is authoritative. Gen 7/8 retain eligible transfers (including HM/regional-evolution restrictions); Gen 9 applies HOME move reset. Inherited tables are valid native provenance, not Champions explicit-mod proof.

Movepools are individual move availability, not a validator for inter-move/event/ability/level compatibility. Unavailable moves are omitted; Sketch follows the pinned source. Typed Hidden Power aliases expand only a proven Hidden Power pool and require separate innate-IV context at calculation time.

Exact Showdown identities/stats/types/weight are retained. Only source-declared cosmetics and Aegislash's explicit Shield base forme can share an engine identity; there is no generic base-form fallback.

Source-declared Gmax placeholders are represented by gmaxNames and canGigantamax on real SwSh species, never as zero-weight species or automatically active transformations. Future-game mechanic metadata is not activated by presence in inherited source data.

Engine parity checks identity, types, category, power, base stats, weight, gender when present, Mega targets and applicable Z/Max power metadata. Presence/parity alone does not prove all ability/item effects or calculation mechanics; the application must gate context and unsupported mechanics.

Status-Z bonuses, called moves, residual Gmax turns, multi-turn battle history and competitive origin/combination clauses are not simulated by this catalog. No Champions usage rankings are applied to native games.
